_about: Public-domain Sir Thomas Browne (1605-1682), physician of Norwich and author of Religio Medici, for the Word Hoard: his collected Works (1686), Simon Wilkin's four-volume edition (1835-36), Hydriotaphia with The Garden of Cyrus in its first edition (1658), Christian Morals in its first edition (Cambridge, 1716) and Willis Bund's Religio Medici, Hydriotaphia and Letter to a Friend (1869), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

tbrowne-religio-bund: Religio Medici, Hydriotaphia, and the Letter to a Friend, with an introduction and notes by J. W. Willis Bund (London: Sampson Low, Son, and Marston, 1869)

tbrowne-works-1686: The Works of the Learned Sr Thomas Brown, containing Vulgar Errors, Religio Medici, Hydriotaphia with the Garden of Cyrus, and Certain Miscellany Tracts (London: Basset, Chiswell, Sawbridge, Mearn and Brome, 1686)
tbrowne-wilkin-1: Sir Thomas Browne's Works, including his Life and Correspondence, edited by Simon Wilkin (London: William Pickering; Norwich: Josiah Fletcher, 1836), vol. I
tbrowne-wilkin-2: Sir Thomas Browne's Works, including his Life and Correspondence, edited by Simon Wilkin (London: William Pickering; Norwich: Josiah Fletcher, 1835), vol. II
tbrowne-wilkin-3: Sir Thomas Browne's Works, including his Life and Correspondence, edited by Simon Wilkin (London: William Pickering; Norwich: Josiah Fletcher, 1835), vol. III
tbrowne-wilkin-4: Sir Thomas Browne's Works, including his Life and Correspondence, edited by Simon Wilkin (London: William Pickering; Norwich: Josiah Fletcher, 1835), vol. IV
tbrowne-hydriotaphia-1658: Hydriotaphia, Urne-Buriall, together with The Garden of Cyrus (London: Hen. Brome, 1658), the first edition
tbrowne-christian-morals-1716: Christian Morals, published from the original and correct manuscript of the author by John Jeffery (Cambridge: University Press, for Cornelius Crownfield; year OCR'd '1916', catalogued 1716), the first edition

_alternates.tbrowne-copies: Wilkin's edition reissued by Bohn (1846, four volumes); Religio Medici fourth edition (catalogued 1656) and seventh (1678); Sayle's Works (PG 39960-39962, 1904-07); CCEL browne/religio (from the Harvard Classics) and browne/morals (Rivingtons, 1863)

_excluded.tbrowne-later: A post-1924 facsimile Hydriotaphia catalogued 1658; Harvard Classics and other many-author volumes; Keynes's 1928 edition
